The park's Cragg Foundation page says it opened in 2008 under the Cragg family's nonprofit foundation, and the imprint names the Cragg Foundation as publisher.

The statutes of the Kulturstiftung Landkreis Leipzig (30 September 2020) say the district founded it, the Landrat chairs its Stiftungsrat (section 8), the Stiftungsrat elects the Vorstand and adopts the Wirtschaftsplan (section 9), and the Free State of Saxony supervises it (section 18); section 2 puts Haus Rabe in its ownership.

The consolidated founding charter of 7 March 2022 (pages 1, 2 and 4) makes the museum a budgetary body whose director the president of the Hungarian Academy of Arts appoints under the Labour Code, the institution's documents page names the State Audit Office as its external auditor, and the villa page shows the museum's staff ran the villa's rehabilitation.
